start.title: Walking Away
start.text:
You and your friend leave the city.
Hope has died on a Roman cross.

choices.feedback: Despair is not the last word.
Luke 24:14 — Cleopas and his companion were discussing everything that had happened.

argue_consequence.title: Not Abandoned
argue_consequence.text:
Sorrow speaks loudly, but listen.
Walk on. The road is not done.

boast_consequence.title: Not Pride
boast_consequence.text:
No one foresaw this morning.
Walk simply. Carry the grief.

stranger_joins.title: A Quiet Traveler
stranger_joins.text:
A stranger falls in step beside you.
"What are you discussing?" he asks.

choices.feedback: Luke 24:17 — Cleopas and his companion stopped, their faces downcast, when the stranger asked what they were discussing.

refuse_consequence.title: Welcome Him
refuse_consequence.text:
A road shared is grief halved.
Speak. The stranger listens.

mock_consequence.title: Not Mockery
mock_consequence.text:
He has asked in kindness.
Answer him in kind.

share_grief.title: Concerning Jesus
share_grief.text:
"He was a prophet, mighty in word.
They crucified Him. We had hoped..."

choices.feedback: Luke 24:19-21 — Cleopas and his companion explained to the stranger about Jesus of Nazareth, a prophet they had hoped would redeem Israel, but who had been crucified.

choices.text: Blame the women for the rumor
Cut the story short in shame
choices.feedback: Tell it whole. He is listening.

blame_consequence.title: Do Not Blame
blame_consequence.text:
The women carried only what they saw.
Tell the story whole.

short_consequence.title: Tell It All
short_consequence.text:
Hide nothing from this stranger.
He is more present than you know.

scripture.title: Foolish and Slow
scripture.text:
"Did the Christ not have to suffer
and so enter into His glory?"

choices.feedback: Luke 24:27 — The stranger explained to Cleopas and his companion what was said in all the Scriptures concerning himself, beginning with Moses and all the Prophets.

offense_consequence.title: Not Offense
offense_consequence.text:
His sharpness is the surgeon's blade.
Receive it. It is healing you.

interrupt_consequence.title: Be Still
interrupt_consequence.text:
You do not yet see what he sees.
Let him finish. Then you will know.

burning_hearts.title: Hearts Aflame
burning_hearts.text:
Something kindles inside your chest.
You cannot name it, but it burns.

choices.feedback: Luke 24:32 — Cleopas and his companion later realized their hearts were burning within them while the stranger talked with them on the road and opened the Scriptures to them.

distrust_consequence.title: Trust the Fire
distrust_consequence.text:
Your heart knows before your mind.
Let it lead you forward.

demand_consequence.title: Not Demand
demand_consequence.text:
Heaven does not yield to demand.
Receive softly. Be carried.

invite_stay.title: Emmaus Village
invite_stay.text:
The village nears. He acts as if to go on.
The sun sinks low.

choices.feedback: Luke 24:29 — Cleopas and his companion urged the stranger strongly, saying, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over."

letgo_consequence.title: Do Not Lose Him
letgo_consequence.text:
Some moments must be held.
Call him back. Beg him to stay.

charge_consequence.title: Not for Price
charge_consequence.text:
A guest is welcomed, not sold to.
Open your door freely.

choices.feedback: You set the table for three.

breaking_bread.title: He Took the Bread
breaking_bread.text:
He takes the bread. Blesses it.
Breaks it. Hands it to you.

choices.text: Look at His hands. See Him.
choices.feedback: Luke 24:30-31 — When the stranger was at the table with Cleopas and his companion, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them, and their eyes were opened.
This is no time for pride.

look_consequence.title: Lift Your Eyes
look_consequence.text:
Do not miss this for hunger.
The Guest is the Lord.

choices.text: Look at His hands. See Him.

host_consequence.title: Not Pride
host_consequence.text:
Your bread became His blessing.
Look. Receive. Be still.

choices.text: Look at His hands. See Him.

recognition.title: He Vanishes
recognition.text:
It is the Lord! Your eyes are opened.
And then He is gone.

choices.text: Sit stunned and stay the night
Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem
choices.feedback: Luke 24:33 — Cleopas and his companion got up and returned at once to Jerusalem after recognizing the Lord.

stay_consequence.title: Do Not Wait
stay_consequence.text:
The night is no obstacle now.
Go. The eleven must hear.

choices.text: Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem

whisper_consequence.title: Tell Them All
whisper_consequence.text:
This is not a secret to keep.
Let the city hear, "He lives!"

choices.text: Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem
choices.feedback: You set out into the dusk.

ending.title: He Is Risen Indeed
ending.text:
You burst in: "The Lord is risen!
He broke bread with us tonight."
